solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Document from Manchester United's vault picked up

indicators.note: something picked up is heard, as on a radio, so the phrase before it is what is said aloud

parts.note: Man U is the usual short name for the football club Manchester United, so Man U's; a crypt is an underground vault beneath a church

explanation.surface: A paper retrieved from a vault belonging to the football club.
explanation.walkthrough: MAN U'S CRYPT, said aloud, gives the answer. Man U is the everyday name for Manchester United, an English football club.
explanation.definitionFit: A handwritten or typed original text is a kind of document.

clue.text: Dramatic technique encountered doing chat, strangely

parts.note: met means encountered

indicators.note: the words doing chat are arranged in a strange new order

explanation.surface: Someone meets a style of acting while chatting oddly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doing chat' reads as idle talk, but 'strangely' marks those two words as letters to rearrange (into HODACTING); the definition is the opening two words.
explanation.definitionFit: This acting approach, from Stanislavski, has performers live their role's emotions; it is a stage technique.

clue.text: Near end of flight in darkness

parts.note: nigh means near

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, here of flight

explanation.surface: A plane's journey is nearly over as dusk falls.
explanation.definitionFit: The hours without daylight are synonymous with darkness.

clue.text: Way of addressing a man in business I respect

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A polite form of address used for a respected businessman.
explanation.definitionFit: The respectful title used when speaking to a man, as in 'Yes, sir'.

clue.text: Budget speech lacking nothing

indicators.note: lacking means without, so the letter for nothing is taken away

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech
O, the zero shape, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: A Budget statement with no content, as a Chancellor might deliver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Budget' looks like the annual financial statement; here it is a verb meaning to allow a limited amount.
explanation.definitionFit: To ration something is to dole it out in fixed allowances, which is to budget it.

clue.text: Who may give injured camper aid?

definitions.text: Who may give injured camper aid?

indicators.note: injured letters are damaged and put back together in another order

explanation.surface: A question about who helps a hurt holidaymaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'injured' rearranges CAMPER AID, and the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambulance crew trained in emergency care are exactly who would treat a hurt camper.

clue.text: Deserter, that woman? On the contrary

parts.note: a rat is someone who deserts a cause, like rats leaving a sinking ship
her refers to that woman

explanation.surface: Someone protests: is she a deserter? Quite the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: Used to correct a statement ('not cold; rather, hot'), it works like the phrase introducing a contradiction.

clue.text: Not yet resolved, working men endured it

indicators.note: working means the letters are put to work in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Labourers put up with a dispute that remains unsettled.
explanation.definitionFit: Something still undecided has not been fixed or settled.

clue.text: Row involving tail of big animal

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the row wraps round the letter

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its last letter, here of big

explanation.surface: An argument about a large creature's tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' suggests a quarrel, but here it is a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: The striped big cat is an example of an animal.

clue.text: Trainer struggling to find ground

indicators.note: struggling letters are thrown about and fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A coach having trouble locating a pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrain is a stretch of land considered for its physical features, so ground.

clue.text: Playing one's best against spinner for Middlesex, initially

parts.note: on can mean against, as in leaning on a wall
a top is a toy that spins

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of Middlesex

explanation.surface: A cricketer bowling spin for the county team Middlesex at their peak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinner' suggests a spin bowler in cricket; here it is a toy. Middlesex is an English county cricket side.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes performing at the peak of one's ability.

clue.text: Left large-sized book in case

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
a folio is a book of the largest page size

explanation.surface: A big book abandoned inside a container.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' looks like a past tense of leave; here it is the side of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat carrying case for loose papers or drawings is called a portfolio.

clue.text: Male carrying old gardening implement

indicators.note: carrying means holding within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: A man carrying an antique garden tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-handled tool for weeding is an example of a gardening implement.

clue.text: Change horse's headgear after heading off

indicators.note: with its heading off, the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a halter is a rope or strap fitted round a horse's head

explanation.surface: Swapping a horse's bridle once it has been taken off its head.
explanation.definitionFit: To alter is to modify, a direct synonym of change.

clue.text: Deal with leader of youth convention

parts.note: to treat a matter is to deal with it

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of youth

explanation.surface: Handling the head of a youth conference.
explanation.walkthrough: 'convention' suggests a gathering; here it means a formal agreement between states.
explanation.definitionFit: An international treaty is also called a convention, as in the Geneva Convention.

clue.text: Mournful song's awful, including its ending?

indicators.note: including means holding inside, so the letter goes within

parts.note: dire means awful
its refers back to song, whose final letter is G

explanation.surface: A sad tune is terrible, ending and all?
explanation.walkthrough: 'its ending' is the last letter of song, the word it refers to.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirge is a lament played or sung at a funeral.

clue.text: Show shield

definitions.meaning: to ... a film is to show it

explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both broadcasting a programme and protecting from view or harm.

clue.text: Secure link

definitions.meaning: a bond or connection between people

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means fasten with a knot; as a noun, a bond joining two things.

clue.text: Applied to cheek, the best cosmetic

indicators.note: applied to means put after, so the second piece follows the first

parts.note: face can mean cheek or nerve, as in 'had the face to ask'
the cream is the best part, as in the cream of the crop

explanation.surface: Rubbing the finest beauty product into one's cheek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cheek' looks like part of the face, which it is, but it stands for impudence.
explanation.definitionFit: A moisturising lotion for the skin is a cosmetic product.

clue.text: Large antelope from eastern country

parts.note: a land is a country

explanation.surface: A big antelope that comes from a nation in the east.
explanation.definitionFit: The eland of Africa is the largest kind of antelope.

clue.text: Girl's name, one in a story

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a tale is a story
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A girl's name turns up as a character in a tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Girl's name' reads as the definition, but name gives N and only Girl defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Natalie is a female first name, so an example of a girl.

clue.text: Bishop and knight eating uncooked beef

indicators.note: eating means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
N is the chess abbreviation for knight
raw means uncooked

explanation.surface: Two chess pieces dining on raw steak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beef' suggests meat; here it means muscle.
explanation.definitionFit: Beef in the sense of muscular strength is brawn.

clue.text: Voice disapproval when volume reduced

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a volume is a book

explanation.surface: Jeering once the sound is turned down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'volume' looks like loudness; here it is a book.
explanation.definitionFit: To boo is to jeer, expressing disapproval out loud.

clue.text: Unhappy having lots of money moved electronically?

parts.note: down means low in spirits, unhappy
loaded is slang for rich

explanation.surface: A rich person who is miserable having had their money transferred online.
explanation.definitionFit: Files transferred from the internet to a device have been fetched over a network.
